# AXE Contracting Group

> General contractor based in Staten Island, New York. Residential and commercial roofing, painting, remodeling, flooring, additions, pavers, decks, siding, and condo/co-op renovations in Staten Island, Brooklyn and Manhattan.

- Phone: (347) 265-1229
- Email: support@axecontracting.org
- Hours: Mon–Sat · 8:00 AM – 6:00 PM
- Google Business Profile: https://share.google/VGBW093pRHXSenrR7

## Services
- [Roofing & Roof Replacement](https://axecontracting.org/services/roofing/): Full roof replacements for Staten Island homes, two-families and small commercial buildings, including asphalt shingle, flat roof membrane, flashing and gutters.
- [Roof Repair & Leak Repair](https://axecontracting.org/services/roof-repair/): A stain on the ceiling is rarely directly under the leak. We find where the water actually gets in, fix that spot, and show you photos of the repair.
- [Siding Installation & Replacement](https://axecontracting.org/services/siding/): New siding over a properly wrapped and flashed wall. Vinyl, insulated vinyl, and fiber-cement, with trim, soffit and fascia to match.
- [Exterior Painting](https://axecontracting.org/services/exterior-painting/): Most of an exterior paint job is prep, and we do it all. Scrape, sand, repair, prime, caulk, then two finish coats.
- [Pavers, Patios, Driveways & Masonry](https://axecontracting.org/services/pavers-masonry/): Paver driveways, patios and walkways built on an excavated and compacted base, plus stoop, step and retaining-wall masonry.
- [Decks & Porches](https://axecontracting.org/services/decks/): New decks, rebuilds and porch repairs on proper footings and properly attached ledgers, in pressure-treated lumber or composite.
- [Interior Painting](https://axecontracting.org/services/interior-painting/): Walls, ceilings, trim and doors for homes, apartments and condos. A quote the day after the walkthrough, and a crew that cleans up like it's their own place.
- [Kitchen Remodeling](https://axecontracting.org/services/kitchen-remodeling/): Cabinets, counters, tile, floors, lighting and the licensed trades behind them, all on one schedule run by one general contractor.
- [Bathroom Remodeling](https://axecontracting.org/services/bathroom-remodeling/): Tile showers that are waterproofed behind the tile, tub-to-shower conversions, vanities, ventilation and licensed plumbing.
- [Basement Finishing & Renovation](https://axecontracting.org/services/basement-finishing/): We fix the moisture first, then insulate, frame and finish with materials that can tolerate a below-grade space.
- [Flooring Installation](https://axecontracting.org/services/flooring/): Hardwood, engineered wood, luxury vinyl plank and tile, installed over a subfloor we've flattened first.
- [Whole-Home & Gut Renovations](https://axecontracting.org/services/home-renovations/): From one floor to the whole house, down to the studs if needed. One general contractor running every trade, with one schedule and one point of contact.
- [Home Additions & Extensions](https://axecontracting.org/services/home-additions/): Rear extensions, second-story additions and dormers, built to approved plans and tied cleanly into the existing roof, siding and interior.
- [Condo, Co-op & Apartment Renovations](https://axecontracting.org/services/condo-apartment-renovations/): A contractor your managing agent will approve. We provide COIs naming the building, follow the alteration agreement, and work within building hours.
- [Commercial & Storefront Build-Outs](https://axecontracting.org/services/commercial-construction/): Storefronts, barbershops, lounges, restaurants and offices, built on a schedule that respects your opening date.

## Service areas
- [Staten Island](https://axecontracting.org/areas/staten-island/): We're based here. Roofs, renovations, paint and pavers from St. George to Tottenville, by a crew that knows the island's houses.
- [North Shore](https://axecontracting.org/areas/staten-island/north-shore/): St. George, Stapleton, West Brighton, Port Richmond and Mariners Harbor, the island's oldest housing stock. We renovate it without stripping its character.
- [East Shore](https://axecontracting.org/areas/staten-island/east-shore/): South Beach, Midland Beach, Dongan Hills, New Dorp and Oakwood. Wind, salt and flood-zone rules shape every exterior we build here.
- [Mid-Island](https://axecontracting.org/areas/staten-island/mid-island/): Todt Hill, Willowbrook, New Springville and Bulls Head have bigger lots and bigger houses, and owners ready to remodel, add on and upgrade.
- [South Shore](https://axecontracting.org/areas/staten-island/south-shore/): Great Kills, Eltingville, Annadale, Huguenot and Tottenville. Family homes, two-families and big yards, which means roofs, pavers, decks and remodels.
- [Brooklyn](https://axecontracting.org/areas/brooklyn/): Just over the Verrazzano. We take on painting, renovations and roofing in Brooklyn homes, condos and co-ops, with COIs and building paperwork handled.
- [Manhattan](https://axecontracting.org/areas/manhattan/): Condo and co-op renovations, from a fresh coat of paint to new kitchens and baths, with the COIs and building approvals Manhattan buildings require.

## Guides
- [Do I need a permit to renovate in NYC?](https://axecontracting.org/guides/nyc-renovation-permits/): A Staten Island homeowner's guide to what the Department of Buildings cares about, and what it doesn't.
- [Condo & co-op renovations in NYC: COIs and alteration agreements](https://axecontracting.org/guides/condo-coi-alteration-agreement/): The paperwork your building will ask for, and how to get through it without losing a month.
- [Flat roof vs. shingle roof: what fits a Staten Island home?](https://axecontracting.org/guides/flat-roof-vs-shingle-roof/): You usually don't choose. The roof's slope does. But you do choose materials and details, and those decide how long it lasts.
- [How to vet a home improvement contractor in NYC](https://axecontracting.org/guides/how-to-vet-a-contractor-nyc/): A checklist for Staten Island, Brooklyn and Manhattan homeowners before you sign anything.
